cycle.note: Missouri CPE runs by calendar year: 40 hours each year, 2 of them ethics. Licensees in good standing can make up a shortage until March 1 of the next year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: At least 40 hours each calendar year (20 CSR 2010-4.010).

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 2 of the 40 hours each year in ethics. Regulatory and behavioral ethics both count.

newLicensee.note: No CPE is due for the calendar year you were first licensed; the 40 hours start the next January 1.

licenseDateHint: The renewal date on your Missouri license. CPE is tracked by calendar year regardless.
issueDateHint: If you were first licensed this year, no CPE is due until next year.
limitsNotTracked: Authorship: max 2 hours a calendar year (20 CSR 2010-4.020).
March 1 grace: hours taken by March 1 to cure last year's shortage count for last year only — enter them in the year you report them.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for at least 5 calendar years after the year completed (20 CSR 2010-4.031).
toVerify: New licensees: assumed exempt for the calendar year of initial licensure (the rule doesn't prorate).
License renewal timing (sources differ: annual vs. every two years) — the app only uses the date for the renewal reminder.
